title: Battle of Dargo (1845)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Dargo (1845)", at revision 1378218778, opens: "The Battle(s) of Dargo or Dargo Campaign of 1845 was a series of military actions during the Murid War, the eastern phase of the Caucasus War of 1817–1864. During the campaign, Mikhail Vorontsov penetrated too deeply into enemy country, was surrounded, and partially fought his way out with heavy losses and was rescued by General R. K. Freitag." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4530556, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1845 military conflict in the Caucasus". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
